rule: Vision review of each place photo by Grok Bot. confirm = approved in site/heroes/place-photo-choices.json; deny = rejected (use: none); unsure = left pending. Luke authorised applying verdicts on 1 November 2026.
method: Viewed each image (330 px thumbnail) against its place; also read camera EXIF on Commons to enforce the no-drone rule.
